descriptions.normal: A deep-fried Liyue snack. Shredded meat and vegetables are wrapped in a thin pancake, rolled into a tube, and then fried until golden. Crunchy on the outside, smooth on the inside, these little delicacies are cherished by old and young alike.
descriptions.suspicious: A deep-fried Liyue snack. The crust was supposed to be crisp, but somehow it ended up soft and soggy — how strange... Wait, could this be the oil paper used to wrap the food...?
descriptions.delicious: A deep-fried Liyue snack. With a crisp crack, the juicy filling bursts forth as you bite. Beneath the golden, flaky shell are not only layers of flavor, but the vibrant, bustling spirit of Liyue itself.

effectTexts.normal: Increases all party members' DEF by 200 for 300s.
effectTexts.suspicious: Increases all party members' DEF by 165 for 300s.
effectTexts.delicious: Increases all party members' DEF by 235 for 300s.
